text: 首先，我当然不支持卖淫合法，但是我也不会去反驳支持的人。
en: First of all, I certainly do not support the legalisation of prostitution, but I will not argue against those who do.

text: 因为卖淫不合法有一个无法忽视的无敌双标的对照组，包养合法。
en: Because the illegality of prostitution has an impossible-to-ignore, invincibly double-standarded counterpart: being kept is legal.

text: 这甚至可以引申出一些法律问题：
en: This can even lead to some legal questions:

text: 嫖娼者每次都找同一个妓女，虽然是按次收费，但是嫖客按月结算，那么这种行为算包养还是嫖娼。
en: If a client visits the same prostitute every time, and although it is charged per visit, the client settles the bill monthly, then does this behaviour count as being kept, or as soliciting prostitution?

text: 被包养的女性实际上被不止一人包养，她其实在几个包养者中游走，并且不断的抛弃和寻找不同的包养者，那么她算小三还是妓女。
en: A woman who is kept is in fact kept by more than one man; she moves among several benefactors, constantly discarding and seeking out different ones — then is she a mistress or a prostitute?

text: 这个问题的矛盾在于，低价卖“一次性的快餐”不合法，高价卖“长期提供食物”却合法。
en: The contradiction in this question is that selling 'one-off fast food' at a low price is illegal, yet selling 'food provided over the long term' at a high price is legal.

text: 有些女性求富哥包养，结婚要求天价彩礼，房产加名，其实和卖没有区别，只是一个短期一个长期罢了，但这些却都是合法的。
en: Some women seek to be kept by wealthy men, demanding sky-high bride prices and adding their names to the property deeds upon marriage; this is in truth no different from selling oneself — merely short-term versus long-term — yet all of this is legal.

text: 这样做导致了两个问题：
en: This has led to two problems:

text: 一是只堵死了低价交易，却没堵死高价交易，低价市场由于风险大没人敢做，导致供给少需求大，供不应求，价格越来越高。
en: First, it has only blocked the low-price trade while leaving the high-price trade unblocked; because the low-price market carries great risk, no one dares to operate in it, leading to scarce supply and great demand, so supply falls short of demand and prices keep climbing.

text: 二是因为价格虚高泡沫，导致对穷人限制很死，对富人却无限制，穷人想买“一次性快餐”不合法，想买“长期提供食物”又买不起，而富人钱多，随随便便就可以买到很多人“长期提供食物”。
en: Second, because of the inflated bubble in prices, the poor face rigid restrictions while the rich face none. The poor are not allowed to buy 'one-off fast food' and cannot afford to buy 'food provided over the long term', whereas the rich, with plenty of money, can casually buy 'food provided over the long term' from many people.

text: 其实我们国家，仅以城市而论，
en: In fact, taking our country's cities alone,

text: 在某个时期，是真的完全杜绝了组织卖淫的。
en: there was a period when organised prostitution was truly eliminated entirely.

text: 并且，我怀疑，很可能无组织的，个人卖淫，也被断绝了。
en: And I suspect that even unorganised, individual prostitution was probably cut off as well.

text: 不仅是卖淫，黄赌毒，都被断绝了。
en: Not only prostitution, but pornography, gambling and drugs were all eradicated.

text: 是的，你没猜错，就是建国后到改开前那段时间。
en: Yes, you have guessed right — it was the period after the founding of the nation and before the Reform and Opening-up.

text: 我曾经听家里的老人说过那段时期。
en: I once heard the elderly in my family speak of that period.

text: 那段时期，不要说卖淫了，
en: In that period, not to mention prostitution,

text: 就是谈对象，都是组织介绍的。
en: even courtship was arranged by the organisation.

text: 俩人谈对象，别说开房了，
en: When two people were courting, not to mention booking a hotel room,

text: 就是亲个嘴都得偷偷地。
en: even a kiss had to be stolen in secret.

text: 至于说什么海王海后啊，
en: As for so-called sea kings and sea queens,

text: 那是想都不会想的，
en: that was something no one would even think of;

text: 脑子里就没有那个概念，
en: the very concept did not exist in people's minds,

text: 就好像你无法想象色彩斑斓的黑一样。
en: rather like how you cannot imagine a colourful black.

text: 因为那个时期，一个城市职工，
en: Because in that period, an urban worker,

text: 从生到死，
en: from birth to death,

text: 你的一切，
en: everything about you,

text: 都是被组织安排的。
en: was arranged by the organisation.

text: 那会儿有个案例，就是说苏联间谍，
en: There was a case back then, about a Soviet spy,

text: 从黑龙江偷渡过来，
en: who sneaked across the border from Heilongjiang,

text: 结果刚过来没多久，
en: but shortly after arriving,

text: 就被农场的人发现了。
en: he was discovered by people on a state farm.

text: 大家发现一个生面孔，
en: When everyone noticed an unfamiliar face,

text: 很快就上报组织，
en: they quickly reported it to the organisation,

text: 然后很快就被抓住了。
en: and he was soon caught.

text: 我爷爷就说，
en: My grandfather said,

text: 那会整个人什么想法也没有，
en: back then a person had no thoughts of their own at all,

text: 就是一个字儿，干。
en: just one word: do.

text: 厂里让怎么干，就怎么干。
en: Whatever the factory told you to do, you did.

text: 正常的工作结束后，下了班还得开学习会，总结会。
en: After the normal workday ended, off the clock you still had to attend study meetings and review meetings.

text: 第二天早上还要开晨会。
en: The next morning you had to attend a morning meeting as well.

text: 周天还得被安排去组织参加各种义务劳动。
en: On Sundays you were still assigned to take part in various kinds of voluntary labour organised by the unit.

text: 不过那会儿单位也很有人情味。
en: Still, the work unit back then had a very human warmth to it.

text: 谁家有了小孩儿，
en: When any family had a baby,

text: 大家都会照顾。
en: everyone would look after them.

text: （想象一下，今天的互联网精英们，带着小baby上班，
en: (Imagine, today's internet elites bringing their little babies to work,

text: 爸爸在写代码，baby跟HR阿姨玩儿翻花绳，那画面太美，不敢想）
en: daddy writing code while baby plays cat's cradle with Auntie HR — the scene is too beautiful to contemplate)

text: 职工带着孩子上班，是经常事儿。
en: It was a common thing for workers to bring their children to work.

text: 答主小时候，还赶上个尾巴，
en: When I (the author) was little, I caught the tail end of it,

text: 就被我妈带到过厂里的收发室，
en: and my mum once took me to the factory's mailroom,

text: 跟一群职工家的小孩儿去厂外的草丛里抓蚂蚱。
en: to catch grasshoppers in the grass outside the factory with a bunch of other workers' children.

text: 在这种背景下，大家就没有卖淫的概念。
en: Against this backdrop, people had no concept of prostitution.

text: 那都不是说耻辱不耻辱，合法不合法的问题，
en: It was not even a question of shame or no shame, legal or illegal;

text: 那就是色彩斑斓的黑，
en: it was a colourful black,

text: 大家理解不了，
en: something people could not comprehend,

text: 想象不出来。
en: something they could not imagine.

text: 当然，答主出生在城市职工家庭，能够说的，也就是城市职工的情况，
en: Of course, as the author was born into an urban worker's family, what I can speak of is only the situation of urban workers,

text: 至于说广阔天地，大有可为的农村什么情况，
en: as for the vast countryside, where there was great scope for endeavour, and what things were like there,

text: 答主没有调查过，所以没有发言权。
en: I have not investigated it, so I have no right to speak.

text: 但是仅以城市人口论，这么大规模的人口集群，完全杜绝了黄赌毒，
en: But taking only the urban population, such a large-scale population cluster having completely eradicated pornography, gambling and drugs,

text: 确实是中国古往今来，甚至也可能是世界范围内，极为少见的一段时期了。
en: was truly a period rare not only in China's entire history, but perhaps even in the world.

text: 那答主说了这么多，
en: So having said all this, author that I am,

text: 想表达什么呢。
en: what is it I wish to express?

text: 就是你想给人某种约束，
en: It is simply that if you wish to impose some constraint on people,

text: 让人听从你的建议，
en: and have them follow your advice,

text: 你至少得给人做好安排。
en: you must at least make proper arrangements for them.

text: 就好比你爹妈不让你去外地工作，
en: It is like your parents forbidding you from working away from home,

text: 那你爹妈至少得让你在本地有口饭吃，有点体面的社交圈子。
en: then at the very least your parents must let you have food to eat locally and some decent social circle.

text: 如果说你饿的都快死了，
en: If you were starving to death,

text: 你爹妈跟你说，
en: and your parents said to you,

text: 宁死不能去外面打工，
en: 'Better die than go and work away from home,'

text: 这多少就有点不太靠谱。
en: that would be rather unreliable.

text: 我想，除了极少部分愚孝入脑的例外，大部分人还是会偷偷溜出去打工的。
en: I think that, apart from a tiny minority who are ensnared by blind filial piety, most people would still slip away to find work.

text: 你想解决卖淫问题，
en: If you want to solve the prostitution problem,

text: 至少得提供两方面解决办法。
en: you must at least provide solutions on two fronts.

text: 第一方面，是解决女性的就业。
en: The first is to solve women's employment.

text: 如果你能像上个世纪的国企一样，
en: If you could be like the state-owned enterprises of the last century,

text: 让女人有一个一辈子稳定的饭碗，
en: and give women a stable livelihood for life,

text: 妇女能顶半天，
en: women can hold up half the sky,

text: 妇女拿着你的饭碗，
en: women holding that livelihood of theirs,

text: 自然也就听你的劝，不去做那出卖身体的生意。
en: will naturally heed your counsel and not go into the business of selling their bodies.

text: 另一方面，你得解决绝大部分男性的生理需求。
en: On the other hand, you must address the physiological needs of the vast majority of men.

text: 你得给男性一个靠得住的饭碗，
en: You must give men a reliable livelihood,

text: 让男人养得起家，
en: so that men can support a family,

text: 然后你再提供一个体面的婚恋介绍媒介，
en: and then you provide a decent matchmaking medium,

text: 比如上个世纪的组织介绍。
en: such as the organisational introductions of the last century.

text: 天天回了家，老婆孩子热抗头，
en: Returning home every day to a wife, children and a warm hearth,

text: 就算有部分海王基因者，想要搞一些色色交易，
en: even those with a bit of 'sea king' in their genes, who might want to engage in some salacious transactions,

text: 也要顾虑一下自己手里的饭碗。
en: would still have to think twice about the livelihood in their hands.

text: 那会谁要是丢了厂里的饭碗，
en: Back then, whoever lost their livelihood at the factory

text: 那可真就是没处要饭了。
en: truly would have had nowhere to beg for food.

text: 至于说搞破鞋这种你情我愿，不涉及金钱的事儿，有没有？
en: As for affairs of the 'wearing broken shoes' sort — mutual and consensual, involving no money — did such things happen?

text: 有的。
en: Yes, they did.

text: 但是很少。
en: But rarely.

text: 因为那会儿不像今天，
en: Because back then it was not like today,

text: 你在公司a名声臭了，辞职换家公司还能继续干。
en: where if your reputation sours at company A, you resign and can carry on at another.

text: 相信很多90后，都听过父母老师这样一句话，
en: I believe many of those born in the 1990s have heard their parents and teachers say this:

text: 这个档案是要跟你一辈子的。
en: 'This personnel file will follow you for life.'

text: 那会儿也是。
en: Back then it was the same.

text: 你的单位是要带一辈子的。
en: Your work unit was to be kept for life.

text: 你搞破鞋，搞出纪律问题，
en: If you had an affair and caused a disciplinary problem,

text: 那是真的要社死的。
en: that truly meant social death.

text: 社死还是轻的，
en: Social death was the light consequence,

text: 搞不好肉体都得遭罪。
en: at worst you might even suffer physical punishment.

text: 所以你会发现很多老工人，即使当年吃的不好，穿的不好，
en: So you will find that many old workers, even though they ate and dressed poorly in those years,

text: 也还是怀念那个时期。
en: still look back on that period with nostalgia.

text: 今天则不然。
en: Today it is different.

text: 今天35岁裁员都快成了体制外的铁律了。
en: Today, being laid off at thirty-five has nearly become an iron law outside the system.

text: 大家都想着怎么能在被社会淘汰前，多捞一笔。
en: Everyone is thinking about how to grab a bit more before being eliminated by society.

text: 你这种方生方死的社会背景下，
en: Under such a precarious, born-only-to-perish social backdrop,

text: 指望道德教化，想彻底干掉涩情行业，
en: to rely on moral edification and expect to thoroughly destroy the porn industry,

text: 那跟爹妈不给你钱，还不让你打工，
en: is no different from parents giving you no money yet forbidding you to work,

text: 有什么分别？
en: what is the difference?
